title: Polynomial diagrams for microstructure modelling
summary: We formulate a framework of polynomial diagrams, which are a generalisation of power diagrams (PDs) and anisotropic power diagrams (APDs) allowing for boundaries between cells to be algebraic curves of a prescribed degree. We show that they arise naturally from rephrasing PDs (APDs) as first-degree (second-degree) instances of linear parametrised minimisation diagrams.
